dct_description_sm: # Japan Typhoon Shanshan: Damage Proxy Maps, Sep 2024 The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these damage proxy maps for Japan Typhoon Shanshan (Sep 2024) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it. ## Maps in this dataset - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Japan, Typhoon Shanshan, 5 Sep 2024, v0.8 wbd** (superseded) - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Japan, Typhoon Shanshan, 5 Sep 2024, v0.8 ** **More map details and files:** **More map details and files:** **Legal Disclaimer:** **Credits:** Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS), Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2024)
